title: docs(spec): agent-consumption optim — strip decision-history in agent view, ask slices, hybrid-drilldown resident, README positioning
feat(section,mcp): agent view strips decision-history materialization — read thick pages without burning journal
why:
R1 of the benchmark cost more via wiki (102k>83k) because agentView kept
the decision-history sentinel region (tens of KB). view=agent now strips
it too, leaving a pointer line; decision history is fetched on demand via
section=Decision history.

title: feat(ask): CLI returns section slices, not just paths — found page = answer in hand
why:
The wiki group burned tokens doing ask.js (path only) then Read whole page.
CLI now prints the matched section's slice (with its func@file anchors)
inline; --paths keeps the old path-only output for scripts.

title: feat(resident): hybrid drilldown — wiki builds frame, func@file anchors drill to source, decision-history on demand
docs(readme): when-to-use positioning — lore is an anchored navigation layer, advantage scales with repo size
docs(spec): prompt-hook — three consumption tiers (soft default / notice / inject), opt-in UserPromptSubmit
feat(lorehook): three-tier consumption hook (soft default / notice / inject) — opt-in UserPromptSubmit
why:
CLAUDE.md resident is session-level and gets diluted in long chats.
UserPromptSubmit hook runs every turn (harness-enforced). notice tier
injects the hybrid-paradigm reminder each turn; inject tier gates on
code-question keywords and injects lore_ask section slices. Soft tier
(default, no hook) unchanged. install writes .claude/settings.local.json
(per-machine), --project for shared.
